أجلعب (form IVq)
# أَجْلَعِبُّ (ʔajlaʕibbu) /ʔad͡ʒ.la.ʕib.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# أَجْلَعِبَّ (ʔajlaʕibba) /ʔad͡ʒ.la.ʕib.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# أَجْلَعِبِّ (ʔajlaʕibbi) /ʔad͡ʒ.la.ʕib.bi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
